name: Police Explorer Cadet Program (Post 991)
org: Philadelphia Police Department, with Learning for Life
what_you_do: Learn about police work. You get mentoring, classroom lessons and hands-on drills. You meet every Saturday at the Police Academy. Cadets also help at parades, runs and city events.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 20 who want a law enforcement career. 14 year olds must be in high school. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian consent. Needs a passing behavior grade, good health for running and agility drills, and no arrests or convictions that would block a future police job.
pay_detail: Pay, stipend or fees are not stated on the pages read.
duration: Every Saturday 10 am to 5 pm at the Philadelphia Police Academy, plus optional summer camps and a Washington DC trip.
deadline_text: The program site says applications are open for 2026-2027. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Use the online intake form on the program site. It is on the Apply and Forms page. If you are under 18, get a parent or guardian to say yes.
notes: Most cadets are not paid, but the pages do not say. Cadets who want to be officers are urged to join the police recruit testing later. Other Explorer camps listed include a Pennsylvania State Police week and a camp at Fort Indiantown Gap.
